combined_allocation_rule.Fx: equal left/right within each axle; fixed front/rear fraction gamma
combined_allocation_rule.Fy: equal front/rear axle totals; within axle proportional to chosen tyre capacity C_i
combined_allocation_rule.scope: constructed force allocation, not a control optimum, slip-compatible handling solution or Tesla specification

assumptions.lateral_transfer_definition: delta=m*ay*h/track is load shifted, not outside-minus-inside
scope: prescribed aero distribution; no additional aero moments
pure-lateral bound: ax=Fx=0 and equal front/rear Fy demand for centered CG
independent individual-tyre peak allocation assumed; steering/slip coupling omitted
no device mass, drag, auxiliary power, camber, compliance, temperature or transient model
all usable bounds end before any wheel unloads; near-zero loads expose model limits
chosen load-sensitivity power law is not fitted data

verification: concavity penalty at fixed total load
residual sign on both sides of each usable root
